row.title: Kernel 9.0.0 pinned by kernel.lock
row.body: Kernel 9.0.0 text lives verbatim in doctrine/kernel-9.0.0.md and is pinned by sha256 in doctrine/kernel.lock; kernel --check fails on drift. 8.2.1 stays as the machine-checked form until 9.0.0 gets its kernel.json. Owner-owned EV registry and step repertoire are protected without a human gate: executor and loops cannot write them, changes come only through a separate slow-loop identity gated by replay and rollback (follow-up item).
